_readme: REVELATOR ILLUMINAE page content. revelator.html reads this file; edit copy here, not in the HTML.
Empty arrays / null fields hide their section automatically. Fill them and the section appears.

Image tags: 'vectorworks' = VECTORWORKS RENDER, 'plot' = PLOT CAPTURE, 'ma3' = GRANDMA3 SCREEN GRAB, 'photo' = PHOTO, 'ai' = RENDER PLACEHOLDER (AI). Anything AI-generated or AI-upscaled MUST be tagged 'ai' AND carry the baked-in stamp on the file itself.
Assets live in images/revelator/{hero,plots,renders,ma3}/ — see images/revelator/README.md for the naming + size spec.

billing.label: HOW IT'S BILLED
billing.title: Flat fee. Separate line.
billing.text: Design is quoted as a flat fee per show or per tour, on its own line, separate from production. You can hand the file to SuperTech LX or to any vendor you already trust. Either way the design credit stays with Revelator Illuminae.
billing._owner_todo: Confirm the billing shape (per show / per tour / retainer) before ship.
